label: At market value
paymentPlan: 10% Down Payment at sales launch; 50% During Construction; 40% On Handover
overview: Golf Grove by Regent is a vibrant new residential development in the heart of Dubai Production City (formerly IMPZ), offering a harmonious blend of modern design, prime connectivity, and eco-conscious living. As a freehold property open to all nationalities, Golf Grove is designed for young professionals, couples, and small families who value quality, sustainability, and a strong sense of community. With studio and 1-bedroom apartments, smart home integration, and lush green surroundings, this project redefines urban luxury living. Its competitive pricing and flexible payment options make it one of Dubai’s most promising residential investments.
